info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Baggages-v1-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Baggage Retrieval API provides access to information about baggage associated with airline flights. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve details about baggage claims and statuses for specific flights. Typical users include airline staff, customer service representatives, and travelers seeking updates on their baggage. With this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiencies and improve customer satisfaction by providing timely and accurate baggage information.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed baggage information associated with specific flights. The information includes baggage allowances, restrictions, and additional services. Utilize this endpoint to ensure compliance with airline baggage policies and provide travelers with accurate baggage details.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving baggage information related to flights. This should include all necessary details to specify the flight and associated baggage inquiries.

200.description: Successfully retrieved baggage information for the specified flights.
